text: It is too expensive for me.
I understand. The 3 kW system is 1,95,000 rupees before the government subsidy of 78,000 rupees, so your net cost is 1,17,000 rupees. Would you like to book your free site survey?
No, it is still too expensive for us.
Okay, what is the monthly EMI again?
The monthly EMI starts from 2,999 rupees for 48 months.
Fine, book the free survey. My name is Kiran, I live in Velachery, Saturday works.
Your details have been saved, Kiran. I have noted that you are in Velachery and Saturday works for you. The free site survey request has been recorded.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
